summary.question: What is each model artifact, and which claims rest on it?
universal_limitations: Trained on the 2019 IEEE-CIS competition dataset; nothing here has been validated against current fraud patterns.
Selected and compared on the validation split. The held-out test split is unused, so every number in this project is a validation number.
Output scores are not probabilities. Class weighting distorts the scale, and the measured distortion is under-prediction on the low-score bulk rather than the inflation the weighting would suggest.
summary.not_suitable_for: Not a deployable fraud model. No production monitoring, no drift handling, no calibrated probability output, no evaluation on unseen data. Suitable only for reproducing and extending this project's measurements.
summary.completeness: Generated by walking models/ and matching each artifact to a family. An artifact matching no family raises rather than being omitted, so the ledger cannot fall silently out of date as runs are added.
summary.facts_are_read_not_transcribed: Metrics, predictor counts, caps and stopping behaviour come from each run's own manifests at generation time. Only role, purpose, limitations and intended use are authored here.

artifacts.purpose: A candidate from the baseline selection, kept as evidence of the comparison rather than discarded. Class weighting at 6,000 rounds was chosen: weighting materially improves PR-AUC at this 3.4% prevalence, and 6,000 rounds beat the original 3,000-round configuration. The weighted_6000 candidate is the one promoted to the frozen baseline, so it and lightgbm_baseline.txt describe the same configuration.
claims_resting_on_it: The baseline selection decision only; no downstream claim rests on these

artifacts.purpose: A candidate from the baseline selection, kept as evidence of the comparison rather than discarded. The weighted_6000 candidate is the one promoted to the frozen baseline, so it and lightgbm_baseline.txt describe the same configuration.
claims_resting_on_it: The baseline selection decision only; no downstream claim rests on these
